text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The New Year. The very first night of the 
crucial Classic Year for Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: —Happy New Year! Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Invited by a senior Trainer, I attended a 
relaxed New Year's party with academy 
staff.
choice_data_list_en: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, it's him! It's him! Aiming for 
this year's Triple Tiara, full of spirit! 
A Trainer to watch out for!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, it's her! It's her! Aiming for 
this year's Triple Tiara, full of spirit! 
A Trainer to watch out for!
choice_data_list_en: Senpai, are you already drunk?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
My, look how splendid you've become...! 
I'm so delighted to introduce you to 
everyone like this!
choice_data_list_en: Senpai, are you already drunk?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, there are so many people who 
want to talk with you! We put together 
this gathering on short notice."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara that you and Ramonu are 
aiming for... After all, no one has ever 
achieved it before.

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Watching an Umamusume win two legs of the 
Tiara route was what inspired me to become 
a Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"If I actually get to see the moment the 
Triple Tiara is achieved... that would be 
insane!!"
choice_data_list: (I see, so it's everyone's dream too...)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We have received great expectations, even 
from those who could not be here today.
choice_data_list: （そうか、みんなの夢でもあるんだな……）
choice_data_list_en: (I see, so it's everyone's dream too...)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This really fires me up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No need to be so stiff, this is just a 
casual get-together! Come on, loosen up a 
bit. How about we chat about your favorite 
races?
choice_data_list_en: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Just what I wanted!
choice_data_list_en: This might take a while, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again feeling the immense gravity of 
taking on the Triple Tiara, I brace 
myself... We talk together about the race, 
and before we know it—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight! All Trainers, get ready to 
race!
choice_data_list:
Senpai, you're definitely drunk, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, that sounds fun! I want to see it too!
choice_data_list_en: Senpai, you're drunk, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Pa-pa-pa-pa-pa-pa-pa! Pa-pa-pa-pa!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't tell me you're drunk too, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list_en: Pa-pa-pa-pah!

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text: Alright! Inside Gate 1 is all mine!
choice_data_list: Ah, we need to draw properly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Oh my.
choice_data_list_en: Ah, wait, draw a ticket properly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Good morning. No, it's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A Happy New Year to you all, I suppose... 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Happy New Year.
choice_data_list_en: R-Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Standing beside her is Symboli Kris S... 
A quiet horse girl who came from America. 
She shares a room with Mejiro Ramonu."
choice_data_list:
Were you two doing independent training 
together?

Were the two of you practicing on your own 
together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list_en: Were the two of you doing extra practice together?
Were the two of you doing extra practice together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What about you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list_en: ...A race... with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yeah, maybe we shouldn't. We're both 
responsible adults, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a shame. So you won't show me?
choice_data_list_en: I-I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't that sound interesting? Hey, Kris 
S."
choice_data_list_en: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...The race strategies from the 
trainers... They could make good reference 
material.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, the responsibility is 
mounting. What should I do? How am I going 
to run...?"
choice_data_list:
No, let's just head back and go to 
sleep...

In any case, let's give it everything 
we've got!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
True! We may not be top-tier, but we are 
still Trainers; we can at least show them 
what planning a strategy looks like!
choice_data_list: 頭脳プレイならあるいは……！
いや、もう帰って寝ましょう……
とにかく自分たちの全力を尽くしましょう！
choice_data_list_en: If we play it smart, then maybe...!
No, let's just go home and go to sleep...
Anyway, let's all give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I eagerly told myself. No matter 
how seriously I planned out strategies, I 
completely forgot that it was this body 
that had to do the running...
choice_data_list: かっこいいところを見せましょう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's show them what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Hic... hic...! M-My stamina... isn't 
holding up at all...

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"S-So heavy, this mud...! Umamusume can 
charge right through muddy tracks no 
problem... but it's impossible for 
humans!"
choice_data_list: I-In the end, it's all about... grit...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Grit. That's right.
choice_data_list_en: I-In the end... it's all guts...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this will be a year full of 
learning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: For them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we're a bit tipsy. We 
wouldn't be able to run a race that Mejiro 
Ramonu and the others could learn from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then, we'll take our leave here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, although I felt a little 
embarrassed... thanks to a good night's 
sleep, it didn't affect my work from the 
next day onward. However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.
choice_data_list: Good work, I'll go pack things up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my.
choice_data_list: お疲れ様、片付けてくるよ
choice_data_list_en: Good work. I'll go clean up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "The track. It's empty, though."
choice_data_list: I-I won't run, so it's okay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if calling out to a child eager to 
run... After training, Mejiro Ramonu had 
occasionally started speaking to her.
choice_data_list: は、走らないから大丈夫……
choice_data_list_en: I-I'm not going to run, so it's fine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu loves races where everyone 
gives their all. If you show her your true 
self, you're bound to gain something from 
it.
choice_data_list: Let's settle this fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list_en: Let's make this a fair and square match!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ready... start!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grown adult, running with everything 
they've got. I don't know how that looks 
to others... but even so!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
choice_data_list: うおおおお！1着はもらった……！
choice_data_list_en: Whoaaaa! First place is mine...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ? ...Is this fun for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because... it makes me laugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Humans are so lovely, aren't they?
